purpose: Close adjacent cross-border China physical-execution service families that could otherwise be repeatedly rediscovered under new names.

AXOHA-MULTISUPPLIER.claim: Current service provides one China-side workflow across multiple suppliers including samples, inspection, issue resolution, consolidation and shipping preparation.

CGF-SORTING-REWORK.claim: Current service explicitly provides 100% defect sorting and rework before or after delivery, assigning inspectors on site according to buyer requirements.

PROQC-SORTING-REWORK.claim: Current global quality provider sells sorting/rework in China and other countries with an established engineering/quality organization.

IFRIT-AFTERSALES.claim: Current China-side after-sales service includes spare-parts sourcing/dispatch, warranty claims, defect resolution, replacements, dispute documentation, reorder management and supplier relationship maintenance.

PINGWEI-SUPPLIER-CLAIMS.claim: Current China legal service for overseas buyers covers supplier identity/contract/asset review, defect and non-delivery claims, inspection/sampling/evidence preservation, negotiation, litigation/arbitration and enforcement planning.

ADA-DEFECT-EVIDENCE.claim: Current legal guidance frames defective-goods recovery around contractual benchmark, representative samples/native records, timely notice, causation and separately proven loss/mitigation.

QGO-BUSINESS-TRAVEL.claim: Current China-side service sells factory visits, supplier meetings, Canton Fair support, transportation, interpreters, accommodation and local coordination through one team and one point of contact.

ENSAMICO-FACTORY-VISITS.claim: Current overseas-buyer service coordinates China factory visits, evidence permissions, supplier meetings and structured follow-up reports while distinguishing commercial visits from certified audits.

PROCURETOURS-FACTORY-VISIT.claim: Current service coordinates China factory appointments, route planning, meeting questions, bilingual conversations and organized post-visit notes for overseas buyers.

closure_matrix.structural_friction: Remote buyer loses momentum and decision quality when supplier identity, sample, quote and first-order steps fragment after the physical event.
Samples arrive through fragmented parcels with identity/version/freight ambiguity before a supplier is chosen.
Buyer must prevent defective units from progressing while converting a defect list into physical containment/correction.
Distance, supplier identity, evidence chain, notice clocks and remedy enforcement make the buyer's post-payment position hard to recover remotely.
Factories and meetings span cities, languages and access constraints; a poorly coordinated itinerary destroys scarce buyer time.

reason: Every examined residual is already substantially packaged by current incumbents or becomes specialist/legal/QC work before a distinct founder-light orchestration edge appears.
